# Supplementary 

## Generating Figures

All figures were produced in RStudio using ggplot2 and saved as PDF files with `pdf()`. For main text Figures 1 and 3, each plot was rendered individually and saved as a separate PDF, and these were then arranged into multi-panel layouts and exported as a final high-quality PDF using Inkscape. Figures 2 and 4 were saved directly from RStudio.

Because the analyses were carried out over an extended period, different scripts were run under slightly different software versions, for example R 4.5.2 or 4.6.0, and ggplot2 3.5.2 or 4.0.3. To ensure that the figures are fully reproducible, each analysis script in our code repository has an accompanying .json file containing the complete `sessionInfo()` output (R version, platform, and the version of every loaded package) from the run that generated that script’s figures. This file is rewritten each time a script is run, and each run also re-saves the figures, so the session information for every script always corresponds to the figures it produced.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- data.frame(
  table(mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)
)

colnames(df) <- c("Population", "Sample size")
# rename
df$Population <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("CHS", "Han, China", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("KHV", "Kinh, Vietnam", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi, Pakistan", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("BEB", "Bengali, Bengal", df$Population)

df$Population <- sub("ESN", "Esan, Nigeria", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("YRI", "Yoruba, Nigeria", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("GWD", "Mandinka, The Gambia", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("LWK", "Luhye, Kenya", df$Population)
df$Population <- sub("MSL", "Mende, Sierra Leone", df$Population)

df$Source <- NA
df$Source <-
  ifelse(df$Population == "Borneo", "Brucato et al., 2016", df$Source)
df$Source <-
  ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Sumba", "Timor"), "Cox et al., 2016", df$Source)
df$Source <-
  ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"),
    "Pierron et al., 2014",
    df$Source
  )
df$Source <- ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Merina", "Betsileo", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego"), "This study", df$Source)
df$Source <- ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Esan, Nigeria", "Yoruba, Nigeria", "Mandinka, The Gambia", "Luhye, Kenya", "Mende, Sierra Leone", "Han, China", "Kinh, Vietnam", "Punjabi, Pakistan", "Bengali, Bengal"), "1000 Genomes Project Consortium, 2015", df$Source)
df$Source <- ifelse(is.na(df$Source), "Fortes-Lima et al., 2024", df$Source)

df$Continent <- NA
df$Continent <- ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Merina", "Betsileo", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"), "Africa - Malagasy", df$Continent)
df$Continent <-
  ifelse(df$Population == "Borneo", "Asia", df$Continent)
df$Continent <-
  ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Sumba", "Timor"), "Asia", df$Continent)
df$Continent <- ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Esan, Nigeria", "Yoruba, Nigeria", "Mandinka, The Gambia", "Luhye, Kenya", "Mende, Sierra Leone"), "Africa", df$Continent)
df$Continent <- ifelse(df$Population %in% c("Han, China", "Kinh, Vietnam", "Punjabi, Pakistan", "Bengali, Bengal"), "Asia", df$Continent)
df$Continent <- ifelse(is.na(df$Continent), "Africa", df$Continent)

df <- rbind(df, c("Total", sum(df$`Sample size`)))
df <- as_tibble(df)
df$`Sample size` <- as.integer(df$`Sample size`)

# Count how many in "Han, China", "Kinh, Vietnam", "Punjabi, Pakistan", "Bengali, Bengal"
df %>% filter(Population %in% c("Han, China", "Kinh, Vietnam", "Punjabi, Pakistan", "Bengali, Bengal")) %>% summarise(total = sum(`Sample size`))
# Count how many in "Esan, Nigeria", "Yoruba, Nigeria", "Mandinka, The Gambia", "Luhye, Kenya", "Mende, Sierra Leone"
df %>% filter(Population %in% c("Esan, Nigeria", "Yoruba, Nigeria", "Mandinka, The Gambia", "Luhye, Kenya", "Mende, Sierra Leone")) %>% summarise(total = sum(`Sample size`))

write.csv(df,
  paste0(res_dir, "sample_sizes_global_dataset.txt"),
  sep = ",",
  qmethod = "double",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

  indiv_filter <- rep("Missingness > 0.1; KING kinship > 0.0884", 8),

  )
)

  filter(!(`ref A` %in% asian & `ref B` %in% asian)) %>%
  filter(!(`ref A` %in% african & `ref B` %in% african))
